ValidationRule.description: Block related users from accessing Fraud Case based on Coaching Workbench Roles-Based Access Control v1.4. User Sharing Rule might give users undesired access to Fraud Case type, so need this VR to block.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Fraud', OR( Owner:User.UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Coach', Owner:User.UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Coach_Lead', Owner:User.UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Content_Writer', Owner:User.UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Quality_Analyst', Owner:User.UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Support_Coach', Owner:User.UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Support_Staff_ARC' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This user does not have access to Fraud Case type.
